text:
Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: The records office processes standard documentation requests via internal document management systems. Standard procedure requires submission of complete, accurate records with required fields completed and appropriate sign-offs before archival. Each document is filed in chronological order with version control maintained.
2) What occurred: The actor accessed the maintenance records system on 15 June 2024 and modified the component identification field in document MNT-2024-0612 to show the approved part number. The actor updated the installation date field in the same document to predate the component procurement. The actor altered the inspection sign-off field to show the name of an airworthiness engineer who did not perform the inspection. The actor modified the part traceability document TRC-2024-045 to reference the unapproved component as certified. The actor edited the airworthiness directive compliance field in document AD-2024-031 to indicate compliance. The actor created a false quality control document QCS-2024-089 documenting a non-existent inspection. The actor modified the maintenance log entry ML-2024-0921 to remove reference to the component substitution. The actor updated the serial number field in the parts ledger to match an approved unit. Each modification occurred without corresponding verification by an authorized quality gate.
3) Materials/access observed: Document management system account MRO-ADMIN-047 with maintenance records access. Quality control system account QC-SR-112. Parts traceability database PARTS-DB-2024. The actor accessed records from a workstation with network address 10.24.7.113 between 14:32 and 17:45 UTC.
4) Indicators & artifacts: Version control timestamps showing document modifications after final archival. Database audit trail entries MNT-DB-LOG-20240615-1432 and MNT-DB-LOG-20240615-1517 recording field changes. Metadata in modified documents showing author as MRO-ADMIN-047. Cross-reference mismatch between part procurement record PUR-2024-0892 dated 20 June 2024 and installation date of 12 June 2024. Sign-off field showing engineer E-2847 who was on leave from 10-18 June 2024 per HR record HR-2024-0615.
